newsitem.title: UK: BPB cautious about H2 trading prospects.
newsitem.headline: BPB cautious about H2 trading prospects.

text.p: Building and packaging materials manufacturer BPB Industries Plc said on Thursday that despite a good performance in its first six months to September 30, 1996, it remained cautious about its second half. the company said in a statement uncertainties in some of its main European markets, patchy recovery in the UK and the strengthening of the sterling could affect the group's performance.
The company on Thursday reported a higher pretax profit for its first six months to September 30 at 106.7 million stg compared with 83.6 million in the previous year.

BPB announced a higher interim dividend of 3.55 pence per share against 3.35p the previous year. On its second half, the company said, "The French commercial sector shows signs of further weakening, and there is a possibility that despite an increase in housing permits, German growth may be lower than generally forecast."
The company said it would be dependent on its plasterboard business for its performance. This business is expected to grow in some developing markets and in North America.

BPB's plasterboard business grew in eastern Europe and said it was planning to two new plants, one each in Poland and the Czech Republic. The company is also building a new plant in Cape Town, South Africa, construction of which was progressing on schedule, it said.
